tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs du ma'i brjod bya sna tshogs pa ming gi sgo nas gsal bar bstan pa nyer mkho blo ldan dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /gzhung lugs du ma'i brjod bya sna tshogs pa ming gi sgo nas gsal bar bstan pa nyer mkho blo ldan dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhung lugs du ma'i brjod bya sna tshogs pa ming gi sgo nas gsal bar bstan pa nyer mkho blo ldan dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

ma lus shes bya mngon gzigs shākya'i rgyal/ /mkhyen rab gter chen mi pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa sogs/ / skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la gus btud nas/ /legs gsungs bka' dang de yi dgongs 'grel las/ /'byung ba'i blang dang dor bya'i chos sogs kyi/ /ming gi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu/ /go sla'i ngag gis gsal bar brjod par bya/ /de yang shes bya gzhal bya gzhi grub pa/ /tshad mas dmigs dang rtogs par bya ba dang*/ /chos dang yod pa yul sogs rnam grangs sngags kyi bklag thabs smra ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs sngags kyi bklag thabs smra ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs sngags kyi bklag thabs smra ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs te/ /don gcig la ni ldog pa tha dad tsam/ /mi rtag dngos po don byed nus pa dang*/ /'dus byas byas pa skyes pa gzhan dbang dang*/ /rang mtshan 'jig pa'i chos rnams don gcig la/ /rtag pa mi 'jig chos dang dngos med chos/ /ma skyes mi 'gag chos sogs don gcig go/ /brten nas gdags pa'i phyir na rten 'brel te/ /blo yi yul yin phyir na shes bya'o/ /don byed nus phyir dngos po zhes bya ste/ /don byed nus med phyir na dngos med do/ /du mar spungs pa'i phyir na phung bo ste/ /skye zhing mched par byed pas skye mched do/ /rang 'bras rgyu yi rigs byed khams su grags/ /des mtshon lhag ma gzhan gyi sgra don kyang*/ /shes par bya ste 'dir ni mang du dogs/ /kun rdzob don dam bden pa rnam pa gnyis/ /chos dang gang zag bdag med pa yang gnyis/ /kun btags gzhan dbang yongs grub mtshan nyid gsum/ /gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang*/ /rnam par shes pa lnga ni phung bo lnga/ /mig rna sna lce lus dang yid kyi dbang*/ /dbang bo drug go gzugs sgra dri ro dang*/ /reg bya chos te yul drug ces bya ba'i/ /dbang yul de dag skye mched bcu gnyis so/

/mig gi rnam shes nas bzung yid kyi bar/ /drug la rnam par shes pa drug ces brjod/ /dbang bo yul dang rnam shes bco brgyad rnams/ khams ni bco brgyad yin zhes mdo las bshad/ /rnam shes drug steng kun gzhi nyon yid gnyis/ /bsnan pas tshogs brgyad dag du 'dod pa'ang yod/ /sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam pa bzhi/ /nam mkha' dang bcas khams ni lngar yang grag /rnam shes dang bcas khams drug ces kyang bya/ /gzugs la kha dog dbyibs gzugs rnam pa gnyis/ /sngo ser dkar dmar rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi/ /sprin dang du ba rdul dang khug sna dang*/ /snang ba mun pa nyi ma grib ma yi/ /yan lag kha dog brgyad du rnam par dbye/ /ring bo thung ngu gru bzhi zlum po dang*/ /mtho dman phyal le ba dang de min pa'i/ /dbyibs kyi gzugs ces bya ba rnam pa brgyad/ /sgra la zin dang ma zin rnam pa gnyis/ /re re la'ang snyan dang mi snyan dbye/ /dri la zhim dang mi zhim rnam pa gnyis/ /mngar ba skyur ba kha ba bska ba dang*/ /tshwa ba lan tshwa ba ste ro drug po/ / re rer drug tu dbye bas so drug 'gyur/ /'byung bzhi 'jam rtsub lci yang bkres skom dang*/ /grang ba bdun ni reg bya bcu gcig go/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog lam bden pa bzhi/ /re re la yang rnam bzhi bcu drug ste/ /sdug bsngal mi rtag stong ba bdag med bzhi/ /kun 'byung rgyu dang rab skye rkyen dang bzhi/ / 'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges 'byung bzhi/ /lam dang sgrub pa rig pa nges 'byin bzhi/ /mi rtag la sogs bcu drug ces su grags/ /ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes pa dang*/ /ming gzugs skye mched drug dang reg tshor ba/ /sred dang len pa srid las skye ba dang*/ /rga shi dang bcas yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /sa 'og sa steng sa bla 'jig rten gsum/ /'di dag la ni srid gsum ces su'ang grag / 'dod khams gzugs dang gzugs med khams gsum brjod/ /'dzam gling lus 'phags ba lang spyod dang ni/

/sgra mi snyan te gling bzhi zhes bya zhing*/ /lus dang lus 'phags la sogs gling phran brgyad/ /ri rab mtha' skor gser gyi ri bdun te/ /de yang gnya' shing 'dzin dang gshol mda' 'dzin/ /seng ldeng can dang lta na sdug ri dang*/ /rta sna can dang rnam 'dud mu khyud 'dzin/ /gling bzhi nas ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar/ /phyogs gcig bsdoms byas stong du longs pa la/ /stong ni dang po'o de nyid stong longs par/ /stong gnyis pa ste 'di yang stong longs tshe/ /stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten khams su bzhag khor yug lcags ri chen po gcig gis bskor/ /de nang gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yod/ / dpyid dang dbyar ston dgun ni dus bzhi ste/ /lo la byi ba'i lo sogs bcu gnyis 'dod/ /re rer 'byung ba'i dbye bas lnga lnga dang*/ /rab byung la sogs lo 'gros drug cur grag /smin drug la sogs rgyu skar nyer bdun te/ /mgo rgyal la sogs nya skar bcu gnyis dang*/ /gzhu khyim la sogs khyim yang bcu gnyis 'dod/ /rgyal chen rigs bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul dbang*/ /'dod lha rigs drug gnas te 'dod khams so/ /tshangs ris tshangs pa 'dun 'don tshangs chen gsum/ /bsam gtan dang po'i 'od chung tshad med 'od/ /'od gsal gsum ni bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas/ /dge chung tshad med dge dang dge rgyas gsum/ /bsam gtan gsum pa'o sprin med bsod nams skyes/ /'bras bu che dang mi che mi gdung ba/ /shin tu mthong dang gya nom 'og min bcas/ /rnam pa 'di brgyad bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gnas/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang*/ /cung zad med dang srid rtse'i gnas skabs ni/ /gzugs med khams te skye mched mu bzhi'o/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og phyogs bcur grags/ /lha dang lha min mi dang dud 'gro dang*/ /yi dwags dmyal ba pa ste rigs drug 'gro/ /lha min lha dang dud 'gror bsdus pa yis/

/'gro ba rgyud lnga dag tu'ang bzhed pa yin/ /rigs drug steng du srid pa bar ma bsnan/ /'jig rten bdun ces mkhas pa gzhan gyis bshad/ /mngal skyes sgong skyes drod gsher las skyes dang*/ /rdzus te skyes bcas skye gnas rnam pa bzhi/ /mtha' 'khob dbang po ma tshang log lta can/ /rgyal ba'i bka' med pa dang lha tshe ring*/ /ngan song gsum bcas mi khom brgyad po dang*/ /bral ba'i khom pa dal ba brgyad du 'dod/ /mi yin dbus skyes dbang po tshang ba dang*/ /las mtha' mi log gnas dang rang 'byor lnga/ /sangs rgyas byon dang chos gsungs bstan pa gnas/ /de rjes 'jug dang gzhan phyir snying brtse ba/ /gzhan 'byor lnga ste dal 'byor chos bco brgyad/ /mthun pa'i yul gnas skyes bu dam pa bsten/ /legs smon 'grub dang sngon gyi bsod nams smin/ /'khor lo chen po bzhi zhes rab tu grag /rigs gzugs 'byor dang dbang phyug shes rab dang*/ /tshe ring nad med mtho ris yon tan bdun/ /dad dang tshul khrims thos dang gtong ba dang*/ /ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod shes rab ste/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun yin zhes brjod par bya/ /yang sos thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod dang*/ /ngu 'bod chen po tsha ba rab tu tsha/ /mnar med tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad du 'dod/ /chu bur can dang chu bur brdol ba dang*/ /so tham/ ma dang kye hud a chu zer/ /ut+pal ltar gas pad+ma ltar gas dang*/ /pad chen ltar gas grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ /nyon mongs sems can lta ba snyigs ma dang*/ /tshe dang dus kyi snyigs ma rnam pa lnga/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ /khyab pa 'du byed sdug bsngal gsum du 'dod/ /nges pa med dang ngoms mi shes pa dang*/ /yang yang 'dor dang nying mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ /mtho dman 'gyur ba grogs med sdug bsngal drug /skye rga na 'chi mi sdug phrad pa dang*/ /sdug pa dang bral 'dod pa btsal ma rnyed/ /nyer len phung 'di sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad/

/nges par 'chi ba nam 'chi cha med pa/ /'chi tshe chos gzhan ma gtogs mi phan pa/ /rtsa ba gsum ste rgyu mtshan dgu bo yang*/ /'chi ba nges par 'ong zhing mi bzlog dang*/ /tshe la snon med 'brid byed bar ma chad/ /gson tshe'ang chos sgrub long med rgyu mtshan gsum/ /des na nges par chos byar thag bcad gcig /'dzam gling tshe la nges pa med pa dang*/ /'chi rkyen mang zhing gson rkyen ches nyung ba/ / lus ni shin tu nyam chung rgyu mtshan gsum/ /da lta nyid nas chos byar thag bcad gnyis/ /'chi tshe nye du sogs kyis mi phan dang*/ /longs spyod zas gos sogs kyis mi phan pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lus 'dis mi phan bcas/ /rgyu mtshan gsum ste des na chos kho na/ /bya bar thag bcad thag bcad rnam pa gsum/ kha gsag gzhogs slong thob kyis 'jal ba dang*/ /rnyed pas rnyed 'tshol tshul chos log 'tsho lnga/ /rnyed dang ma rnyed grags dang ma grags dang*/ /bstod smad bde sdug 'jig rten chos brgyad do/ /pha dang ma dang dgra bcom gsod pa dang*/ / dge 'dun dbyen byed sangs rgyas sku gzugs la/ /ngan sems khrag 'byin mtshams med chen po lnga/ /mar gyur dgra bcom sun phyung slob pa dang*/ /byang sems nges gnas gsod dang dge 'dun gyi/ /'du ba'i sgo 'phrog mchod rten 'jigs pa lnga/ /nye ba'i mtshams med yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /srog gcod ma byin len dang log par g.yem/ /lus kyi las gsum brdzun dang phra ma dang*/ /tshig rtsub ngag kyal bzhi ni ngag gi las/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta yid las gsum/ /mi dge bcu'o bzlog pa dge ba bcu/ /sangs rgyas bstan bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang dman/ /dge 'dun 'du sgo 'phrog dang theg chen smod/ /bla ma'i sku bsdau rdo rje spun dbyen byed/ /sgrub par bar chad byed dang dam tshig bral/ /snying rje med dang log par lta ba can/ /rnam pa bcu ni bsgral ba'i zhing bcur brjod/ /dgra bcom phyir mi 'ong dang rgyun zhugs

kyi/ /lnga brgya phrag gsum 'bras bu'i dus zhes grags/ /shes rab ting 'dzin tshul khrims bslab pa'i dus/ /gsum la sgrub pa'i dus zhes rab tu brjod/ /mngon pa mdo sde 'dul ba'i dus gsum por/ /lung gi dus gsum lnga brgya phrag dgu dang*/ /rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus kyi lnga brgya ba/ /phrag gcig dang bcas lnga brgya phrag bcu'o/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyis/ /skyes bu chung 'bring che gsum skyes bu gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul dang ni thugs kun brjod pa dang*/ /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum/ /bden bzhi mtshan nyid med dang legs phye yi/ /chos 'khor rim pa gsum du bzhed pa yin/ /mngon sum rjes dpag tshad ma rnam pa gnyis/ /dbang po'i mngon sum yid kyi mngon sum dang*/ /rnal 'byor mngon sum rang rig mngon sum bzhi/ / dpyad shes yid dpyod the tshom log shes lnga/ /snang la ma nges pa ste tshad min lnga/ /sems pa'i las dang bsam pa'i las rnam gnyis/ /bsod nams las dang bsod nams min pa'i las/ /mi g.yo'i las te las ni gsum du 'dod/ / gzhan yang mthong chos myong ba'i las nyid dang*/ /skye gnas myong dang lan grangs gzhan myong 'gyur/ /myong bar ma nges las bcas las rnam bzhi/ /tshor ba 'du shes sems pa reg pa dang*/ /yid las byed bcas kun 'gro zhes pa lnga/ / 'dun mos dran ting shes rab yul nges lnga/ /dad dang ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod dang*/ /bag yod btang snyoms rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ /ma chags zhe sdang med dang gti mug med/ /brtson 'grus shin sbyangs dge ba bcu gcig go /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa/ /lta ngan the tshom nyon mongs can dang bcas/ /rtsa nyon drug go phye na lta ba lnga/ /lta min lnga ste bcur 'dod de yang ni/ /lta ba ma gtogs gzhan rnams lta min lnga/ /lta ba la yang 'jig lta log lta dang*/ /mthar lta tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin lta/ /lta ba mchog 'dzin ltar bcas lnga yang yod/

khro dang 'khon 'dzin 'chab dang tshig phrag dog /ser sna g.yo sgyu rgyags dang rnam 'tshe dang*/ khrel med ngo tsha med dang ma dad rgod/ /rmugs dang le lo bag med brjed nges dang*/ /rnam g.yeng shes bzhin ma yin nyi shu rnams/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs zhes byar mngon par bshad/ /'jig lta tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin the tshom gsum/ /kun tu sbyor ba rnam pa gsum zhes bya/ /de steng 'dod la 'dun dang gnod sems gnyis/ /bsnan pas tha ma'i cha mthun kun sbyor lnga/ / gzugs dang gzugs med pas bsdus 'dod chags gnyis/ /rgod dang nga rgyal ma rig rnam lnga la/ /gong ma'i cha mthun kun sbyor lnga zhes brjod/ /gnyid 'gyod rtog dpyod rnams ni gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /'dod la 'dun dang gnod sems gnyid rmugs gnyis/ /'gyod rgod gnyis bsdoms the tshom sgrib pa lnga/ /nyon sgrib shes sgrib sgrib pa rnam pa gnyis/ /snyoms 'jug sgrib pa dang bcas sgrib pa gsum/ /lus ngag yid gsum so so'i sgrib pa dang*/ /thun mong sgrib bcas bzhi ru 'dod pa'ang yod/ /'dod dang sred pa ma rig zag pa gsum/ /gtsang bde rtag bdag lta ba phyin log bzhi/ /gzhan yang kun dkris 'ching ba zag pa sogs/ /rnam grangs du ma yod kyang 'dir ma bris/ /sems can mar shes drin dran drin gzo ba/ /yid 'ong byams pa snying rje lhag bsam drug /byang chub sems bcas rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun/ /kun rdzob don dam byang chub sems mchog gnyis/ /kun rdzob la yang smon sems 'jug sems gnyis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs ni rnam pa gnyis/ /rang don gzhan don dag kyang gnyis su nges/ / chos dang gzugs kyi sku yang gnyis su 'dod/ /klu sgrub ār+ya de ba thogs med dang*/ /dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos grags rgyan drug ste/ /yon tan 'od dang shaka 'od mchog gnyis so/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ /dgra bcom bzhi bo re re'i zhugs pa dang*/

/'bras gnas dbye bas skyes bu zung bzhi'am/ /so sor bgrang bas gang zag ya brgyad do/ /theg dman theg chen theg pa che chung gnyis/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sangs rgyas theg pa gsum/ /bye brag smra ba sems tsam mdo sde ba/ /dbu ma'i grub mtha' smra ba rnam pa bzhi/ /gnas brtan sde dang yod par smra ba'i sde/ /mang pos bkur dang dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /bye brag smra ba'i sde ba rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor lo nor bu la sogs rin chen bdun/ /ral gri pags pa nags tshal gos dang lham/ khang khyim mal cha nye ba'i rin chen bdun/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab bslab pa gsum/ /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa gsum/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra dang don mthun dang*/ /don spyod pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi/ /bsags sbyangs lha dang gdon mchod sbyor ba bzhi/ /lha dang nyon mongs 'chi bdag phung bdud bzhi/ /mngon sangs rgyas dang cho 'phrul chos 'khor dang*/ /lha babs dus ni dus chen bzhi zhes bya/ /khams zas yid sems rnam shes zas bzhir grags/ /sgra dang gtan tshigs bzo dang gso ba dang*/ /nang don rig pa rig gnas che ba lnga/ /skar rtsis mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar dang*/ /snyan ngag dang bcas rig gnas chung ba lnga/ /mchod sbyin srid srung nges brjod snyan ngag bcas/ /rig byed bzhi'o tshangs pa'i yi ge sogs/ /yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa yin/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod dang sdig pa bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /brtan par bzhugs gsol dge ba yongs bsngo ba/ /yan lag bdun pa'o sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ /rjes su yi rang bskul ba'i phung bo gsum/ /gzhan las log par nges dang yang dag nges/ /gang du'ang ma nges phung bo gsum du bshad/ /tshul khrims phung bo ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam par grol dang rnam par grol ba yi/ /ye shes gzigs bcas zag med phung bo lnga/ / rgyu rkyen dmigs rkyen bdag bo'i rkyen nyid dang*/

/de ma thag rkyen rkyen ni rnam pa bzhi/ /nyer len lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu rnam gnyis/ /byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung dang skal mnyam dang*/ /mtshungs ldan kun 'gro rnam smin rgyu bcas drug /rgyu mthun bdag 'bras skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras/ /rnam smin 'bras bu bral 'bras 'bras bu lnga/ /rten gyi stobs dang rnam par sun 'byin stobs/ /nyes las slar ldog gnyen po kun tu spyod/ /stobs bzhi yin te 'phen pa'i stobs la sogs/ /stobs lnga blo sbyong gzhung las bshad pa mthong*/ /yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin dang kha ton byed/ /nyan dang klog len 'chad dang de don sems/ /sgom par byed pa chos spyod rnam pa bcu/ /'pho ba la sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis so/ / 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde sde snod gsum/ /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs bcad dang*/ /ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de lta byung*/ /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas dang rmad du byung*/ /gtan la phab sde yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /dge slong pha ma dge tshul pha ma dang*/ /dge bsnyen pha ma bsnyen gnas dge slob ma'-i/ /sdom pa dang bcas so thar rigs brgyad de/ /bsnyen gnas ma gtogs rigs bdun bzhed pa'ang yod/ /srog gcod ma byin len dang log g.yem dang*/ /rdzun smra chang 'thung lnga spangs dge bsnyen sdom/ /rtsa ba bzhi steng chang dang glu sogs dang*/ khri stan che mtho phyi dro'i kha zas spangs/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad du 'dod pa yin/ /rtsa bzhi chang dang gar sogs phreng sogs dang*/ /mal stan che mtho dus min zas za dang*/ /gser dngul len spangs dge tshul sdom pa bcu/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang lhag ma bcu gsum dang*/ /spang ltung sum cu ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa/ /dgu bcu so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi/ /nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis spangs pa yi/ /dge slong sdom pa nyis brgya lnga bcu gsum/ /dge slong ma dang dge slob ma la yang*/ /gzhan nas shes par bya ste de dag kyang*/

/spang bya'i grangs kyi ldog pas phye nas bzhag /phyag dar khrod pa chos gos gsum pa dang*/ /phying pa ba dang bsod snyoms stan gcig pa/ /zas phyis mi len dgon pa shing drung ba/ /bla gab med dang dur khrod pa dag dang*/ /gzhi ji bzhin dang cog bu pa de rnams/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ldan par grags/ /gzugs phung gang zag bdag tu 'dzin pa dang*/ /bdag gi yin dang bdag la de ldan zhes/ /de la bdag gnas zhes byar 'dzin pa ste/ /de bzhin tshor sogs bzhi la sbyar byas pa/ /'jig tshogs lta ba nyi shu zhes su bshad/ / dgag bya'i bdag ni phung dang gcig nyid min/ /rang bzhin gyis kyang tha dad yod min zhing*/ /phung bo rnams dang rang bzhin gyis mi ldan/ /phung bor rang bzhin gyis ni brten ma yin/ /phung rnams de la'ang de ltar brten pa min/ /phung bo'i tshogs pa bdag min dbyibs ma yin/ /rnam bdun rigs par dbu ma'i gzhung nas bshad/ /bdag las mi skye gzhan las mi skye dang*/ /gnyis las mi skye rgyu med dag las kyang*/ /skye ba med pa mtha' bzhi'i skye ba bral/ /rang bzhin yod pa rtag pa'i mtha' nyid dang*/ /tha snyad du yang med pa chad pa'i mtha'/ /gnyis gar bden par grub dang gnyis min par/ /bden par grub pa bzhi ni mtha' bzhi ru/ /bshad pa'ang yod de cung zad tsam zhig gis/ /'dod tshul tha dad nyid du bzhag pa'ang mthong*/ /bden grub tshul shes dgag bya nges pa'i gnad/ /bdag de phung dang gcig tu med pa dang*/ /ngo bo nyid kyis tha dad min pa dang*/ /de ni yod na phung dang gcig du ma/ /gang rung yin dgos nges pa khyab pa ste/ /gnad bzhi'i dpyad pa zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ /tshogs lam sbyor lam mthong sgom mi slob lam/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gyis phye tshe/ /lnga gsum bco lnga dag tu 'gyur ba yin/ /sbyor lam drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog bzhi/ /mthong sgom gnyis la mnyam rjes gnyis gnyis dang*/ /mnyam gzhag la yang bar chad med lam dang*/

/rnam grol lam zhes bya ba gnyis re yod/ /dang po rab dga' gnyis pa dri ma med/ /gsum pa 'od byed bzhi ba 'od 'phro ba/ / lnga ba sbyangs dka' drug pa mngon du gyur/ /bdun pa ring song brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ /dgu ba legs pa'i blo gros bcu ba ni/ /chos kyi sprin te bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /sangs rgyas sa'o snga ma sa bcur 'dod/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab phyin drug ces brjod de/ /thabs stobs smon lam ye shes phar phyin bcu/ /zang zing chos dang mi 'jigs sbyin pa gsum/ /byams pa dang bcas bzhi ru bshad pa'ang yod/ /nyes spyod sdom dang dge ba chos sdud dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims rnam pa gsum/ /sdug bsngal dang len gnod par ji mi snyam/ /chos la nges thob bzod pa gsum du bzhed/ /go cha'i brtson 'grus dge ba chos sdud dang*/ /sems can don byed brtson 'grus rnam pa gsum/ /kun rdzob don dam la dmigs bsam gtan gnyis/ /de bzhin shes rab la yang phye bar bya/ /'dus byas gang yin kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /'dus ma byas la kun rdzob don dam gnyis/ /kun btags chos rnams kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /yongs grub don dam stong nyid don gcig 'dod/ /nang dang phyi dang phyi nang stong ba nyid/ /chen po don dam 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /mtha' las 'das dang thog ma tha ma med/ /dor ba med dang rang bzhin chos thams cad/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mi dmigs dngos po med/ /ngo bo nyid dang dngos po med pa yi/ /ngo bo nyid de re re'i mthar stong nyid/ /sbyar ba rnams ni stong nyid bco brgyad do/ /phyi ma gnyis po ma gtogs bcu drug nyid/ /nang gi chos rnams bden stong nang stong nyid/ phyi yi chos rnams bden stong phyi stong nyid/ /de bzhin lhag ma rnams kyang shes par bya/ /lus dang tshor ba sems dang chos bzhi yi/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnam pa bzhi/

/mi dge skye 'gyur mi bskyed yang dag spong*/ /mi dge skyes zin spong dang dge ba yang*/ /ma skyes bskyed dang skyes zin spel byed pa'i/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes rab tu bshad/ /'dun dang brtson 'grus sems pa dpyod pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang ba bzhi'o dad pa dang*/ /brtson 'grus dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab lnga/ /dbang bo lnga ste stobs kyang lngar 'byed do/ /dran pa chos rab rnam 'byed brtson 'grus dang*/ /dga' ba shin tu sbyangs dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /btang snyoms byang chub yan lag bdun du 'dod/ /yang dag lta ba rtog pa ngag dang ni/ /las kyi mtha' dang 'tsho ba rtsol ba dang*/ /dran pa ting 'dzin 'phags lam yan lag brgyad/ /de dag byang phyogs so bdun ces su grag /me long ye shes mnyam nyid sor rtog dang*/ /bya grub chos dbyings ye shes ye shes lnga/ /lha yi mig dang sngon gyi gnas shes dang*/ /zag pa zad shes rig pa gsum du 'dod/ /stong ba nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang*/ /smon pa med pa rnam thar sgo gsum mo/ /gzugs can gzugs dang gzugs med gzugs la lta/ /gegs sel sdug dang 'gog pa'i rnam par thar/ /gzugs med bzhi yi rnam par thar bcas brgyad/ /bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med rnam bzhi dang*/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'dug dang bcas mthar gnas dgu/ /sha yi spyan dang lha dang shes rab spyan/ /chos dang sangs rgyas spyan bcas spyan lnga'o/ /lha yi mig gi mngon par shes pa dang*/ /lha yi rna ba gzhan sems shes pa dang*/ /sngon gnas rjes dran rdzu 'phrul zag zad kyi/ /mngon par shes pa dang bcas mngon shes drug /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun tshul khrims dang*/ /gtong ba lha dran rjes su dran pa drug /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen dang rnam smin dang*/ /mos pa sna tshogs khams dang dbang bo'i rim/ /kun 'gro'i lam dang nyon mongs rnam byang dang*/ /sngon gnas rjes dran skye 'pho zag pa zad/ /mkhyen pa'i stobs bcas thub pa'i stobs bcu'o/

/spangs pa phun tshogs rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*/ /bar chad chos dang nges par 'byung ba la/ /dam bca'i 'jigs pa med pa mi 'jigs bzhi/ /chos dang don dang nges pa'i tshig nyid dang*/ /spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa bzhi/ /'khrul dang ca co dran pa nyams mi mnga'/ /mnyam par ma bzhag tha dang 'du shes dang*/ /ma brtags btang snyoms med bcas spyod pa drug /'dun pa brtson 'grus dran dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /shes rab rnam grol nyams pa mi mnga' ba/ /rtogs pa ma 'dres drug dang sku gsung thugs/ dbye bas 'phrin las ma 'dres rnam gsum dang*/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma 'dres gsum/ /phye bas ma 'dres chos ni bco brgyad do/ /tshe dang sems dang yo byad las la dbang*/ /skye ba mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /ye shes chos la dbang ba dbang bcu'o/ /gzhan yang 'byung bzhi sngo ser dkar dmar dang*/ nam mkha' rnam shes dbye bas zad par bcu/ /zil gnon la sogs lhag ma shes par bya/ /phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan sogs mtshan so gnyis/ /sen mo zangs mdog ltar sogs dpe byad bzang*/ /brgyad cu'i khyad par yum gyi mdo nas bshad/ /gsung mnyen 'jam dang yid du 'ong ba sogs/ /yan lag drug cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa ni/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab mdo las gsal/ khyad par mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan nyid nas/ /legs par bshad pa'i nyer mkho 'di lta ste/ /gzhi shes lam shes rnam mkhyen mkhyen pa gsum/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor dang rtse sbyor mthar gyis sbyor/ /skad cig sbyor bcas sbyor ba rnam pa bzhi/ /'bras bu chos sku dang bcas dngos po brgyad/ /'bras bu chos sku'i tshab tu sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes chos sku bsnan pas mngon rtogs brgyad/ /sems bskyed gdams ngag theg chen sbyor lam dang*/ /de rten rang bzhin gnas rigs dmigs pa dang*/ /ched du bya dang go sgrub 'jug pa'i sgrub/ /tshogs sgrub nges 'byung sgrub ces rnam mkhyen nyid/

/ mtshon byed chos ni rnam pa bcu ru bzhed/ /lam shes yan lag nyan thos rang rgyal gyi/ /lam nyid shes pa'i lam shes rnam pa gnyis/ /theg chen mthong lam sgom lam byed pa dang*/ /mos pa sgom lam phan yon bstod bkur bsngags/ / bsngo ba rjes su yi rang sgrub pa dang*/ /rnam dag sgom lam dang bcas lam shes kyi/ /mtshon byed chos ni bcu gcig rab tu bshad/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas lam shes dang*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas lam shes gnyis/ /'bras yum la ring nye ba'i gzhi shes dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i phyogs gzhi shes/ /gzhi shes sbyor dang sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid dang*/ /mthong lam bcas te gzhi shes mtshon byed dgu /sbyor ba'i rnam pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo dang*/ /de yi yon tan skyon dang mtshan nyid bcas/ /thar ba cha mthun nges 'byed cha mthun dang*/ / phyir mi ldog dang srid zhi mnyam nyid sbyor/ /zhing dag sbyor ba thabs mkhas sbyor bar bcas/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed chos bcu gcig /drod rtse bzod pa chos mchog rtse sbyor bzhi/ /mthong lam sgom lam bar chad med rtse sbyor/ /bsal bya log sgrub brgyad bcas rtse sbyor mtshon/ /phyin drug rjes su dran pa rnam drug dang*/ /dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyor/ /bcu gsum mthar gyis sbyor ba mtshon byed do/ /rnam par smin pa ma yin rnam par smin/ /mtshan nyid med dang gnyis su med pa yi/ /skad cig sbyor ba mtshon byed rnam pa bzhi/ /ngo bo nyid sku longs sku sprul sku dang*/ /ye shes chos sku 'phrin las bsdoms byas pa/ /rnam pa bzhi ni chos sku mtshon byed de/ /mdor na don ni bdun cu zhes byar brjod/ /dngos po brgyad du phye ba rgyas pa ste/ /'bring dang bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa'i tshe/ /mkhyen gsum gcig bgrang sbyor bzhi so sor phye/ /'bras bu chos sku dang bcas dngos po drug /yang na mkhyen gsum gcig bsdoms sbyor bzhi yang*/

/gcig tu bgrang nas 'bras bu chos skur bcas/ /dngos po gsum du rnam par bzhag pa yin/ /mngon rtogs rgyan dang rgyud bla mdo sde rgyan/ /chos nyid rnam 'byed dbus mtha' rnam par 'byed/ /byams chos sde lnga zhes ni kun tu grags/ /rtsa ba shes rab rigs pa drug cu ba/ /stong nyid bdun cu zhib mo rnam par 'thag /rtsod zlog rin chen phreng ba rigs tshogs drug /sa yi dngos gzhi rnam grangs bsdu ba dang*/ /rnam par bshad pa'i bsdu ba gzhi bsdu ba/ /gtan la phab pa'i bsdu ba sa sde lnga/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel rnam nges rigs thigs dang*/ /gtan tshigs rigs pa rtsod rigs 'brel ba brtag /rgyud gzhan grub ces tshad ma sde bdun zer/ /de dag nyer mkho ci rigs bris pa ste/ /chos kyi rnam grangs pha mtha'i tshad bral phyir/ /mtha' dag su zhig gis ni brjod par nus/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dang*/ /dbyer med bla ma rnams la phyag btsal nas/ /gsang sngags gzhung nas 'byung ba'i don 'ga' zhig /ming gi sgo nas rnam par bstan par bya/ /bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor rgyud nyid dang*/ /rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi/ /bla med la yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis/ /dang po sbyor ba dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ /las kyi rgyal po mchog ste ting 'dzin gsum/ /skad cig gis bskyed skad cig dkrongs bskyed dang*/ /sa bon phyag mtshan las ni sku rdzogs par/ /bskyed par byed pa cho ga sum bskyed do/ /stong ba nyid las gdan dang sa bon dang*/ /phyag 'tshal sku bskyed mngon byang lnga bskyed de/ /gzhan du cung zad mi 'dra'i khyad par yod/ /zab pa bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ /rgya che ba ni lha yi 'khor lor bzhed/ /gnyis ka zung 'brel zab gsal gnyis med do/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas ma zin par/ /lha yi dkyil 'khor sgom pa mtshan bcas te/ /stong nyid sgom pa mtshan med rnal 'byor ro/

/phyag chen dam rgya chos rgya las rgya bzhir/ /phyag rgya bzhi shes bshad cing de yang ni/ /sku ni phyag chen gsung chos thugs dam tshig /'phrin las las kyi phyag rgya nyid du bshad/ /rnal 'byor rgyud man bdag mdun bum bskyed las/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi rnam par bzhag pa med/ /bla med la ni bskyed rdzogs rim pa gnyis/ /dben gsum sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug la/ /rim pa drug ces 'phags pa lha yis bshad/ /lus dben ngag dben gcig bsdoms sems dben dang*/ /sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug rim pa lngar/ /klu sgrub nyid kyis rim lnga las ni bshad/ /sems dben sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug ces/ /rim pa bzhi ru dpal ldan zla bas bshad/ /'on kyang de dag mi 'gal dbye bsdu tsam/ /sor sdud bsam gtan srog rtsol 'dzin pa dang*/ /rjes dran ting 'dzin yan lag rnam pa drug /sngags dang dam tshig rnal 'byor dbyibs dang ni/ /rnam dag ye shes rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhi/ /snang mched thob gsum 'od gsal bcas pa bzhi/ /'di bzhir stong ba shin tu stong pa dang*/ /stong chen thams cad stong ba zhes byar bshad/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi rdo rje ma lnga dang*/ /kun bzang byams pa ma gtogs sems dpa' drug /re rer rigs lngar phye bas kun bsdoms na/ /dam pa rigs brgya nyid du 'gyur ba ste/ /rnying ma'i dam pa rigs brgya 'di ma yin/ /rnam snang la sogs rigs ni rnam lnga la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rigs ni gsum du 'dod/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang gsang chen rigs gcig go /gzhan yang dbang bzhi bum dbang gsang dbang dang*/ /shes rab ye shes tshig dbang rnam bzhi'o/ /bsam gtan lus dkyil phyi yi dkyil 'khor gsum/ /phyi dkyil la yang rdul tshon ras bris gnyis/ /bla mar smod sogs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'o/ /sa chu me rlung rtsa thig khams drug ldan/ /sha rus la sogs drug tu bzhed pa'ang yod/ /dbu ma ro rkyang rtsa ni rnam pa gsum/

/spyi bo mgrin pa snying kha lte ba yi/ /rtsa 'khor bzhi'am yang na gsang gnas dang*/ /nor bu'i rtsa 'khor zhes bya drug tu'ang 'dod/ /srog 'dzin la sogs rlung ni rnam pa bcu/ /chos longs sprul sku'i bsre ba rnam pa gsum/ /spros bcas la sogs spyod pa gsum du bshad/ /drang don nges don dgongs dang dgongs min dang*/ /ji bzhin sgra dang ji bzhin min sgra ste/ /mtha' drug ces grags spyi don yig don dang*/ /sbas don mthar thug don bcas tshul bzhir bshad/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dbang phyug gsum/ /rdzu 'phrul kun 'gro gnas kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod bskyed dang yon tan dbang phyug bcas/ /dbang phyug brgyad de phra dang rags pa dang*/ /yang ba la sogs dbang phyug yon tan brgyad/ /ril bu mig sman sa bog ral gri dang*/ /nam mkhar 'phur dang mi snang 'chi ba med/ /nad kun 'joms bcas grub pa chen po brgyad/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen dang*/ /rang bzhin med dang snying rjes yongs gang ba/ /rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med pa'i sku/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ces bya bar bshad/ /de la sogs pa mang du yod mod kyang*/ / skabs 'dir rags pa'i rnam gzhag de tsam zhig /brjod pa yis ni gzhan dag dpag bya ste/ /mtha' dag smra ba nus min skabs kyang min/ /de dag kun gyi don ni gang yin par/ /ma rtogs ming tsam bzung ba nyid kyis kyang*/ /phan par 'gyur srid 'on te la la dag /grangs tsam shes nges mkhas par rlom par mtshar/ /rkang grangs tsam zhig shes pa de yis ni/ /mkhas par 'gyur na 'don cha byang ba yi/ /byis pa du ma yod phyir de dag kun/ /mkhas pa'i gnas su 'jog tu rung ngam ci/ kha cig thos pa'i yon tan don mi gnyer/ /gzhan dag cung zad shes pas rgyud khengs nas/ /shes bya'i mtha' yang 'di tsam snyam byed pa/ /gang de blun po min las gzhan ci zhig /de dag la ni lto gos tsam zhig las/

/ji skad brjod pa'i rnam par bzhag pa 'di/ /nye bar mkho ba 'ga' yang yod min kyang*/ /gzur gnas dag la phan srid snyam nas bris/ /'on kyang mdor bsdus mtshon phyir tshigs bcad du/ /bsgrigs pas zhib cha gsal bar ma thon pa'i/ /ma bshad log par bshad pa'i nyes pa gang*/ /dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar 'gyod cing 'chags/ /'dir 'bad las byung dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /ji snyed mchis de 'gro ba mtha' dag gi /rmongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud dang lhan cig tu/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'jug phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di ni gnas brtan shes rab bkra shis kyis bskul ba'i ngor sngar bris pa la/ dad dang rnam dpyod zung du 'brel ba'i dka' bcu ba blo bzang bsam 'grub dang*/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs seng ge gnyis kyis gzhan la'ang phan srid par bsams te/ rang gi chos skal gyi phyir yang par du brko bar bzhed pa'i tshe/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// //dge ba'o// //༄༅/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam mthu ldan pas/ /gsung rab dgongs don 'grel la ches mkhas pa/ /shing rta chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /gzhung don nyer mkho 'thor bu 'di bshad bya/ /'dir dge sogs gsum dang*/ mtshan nyid gsum dang*/ sems sems byung gi rnam gzhag bshad pa gsum/ dang po la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum las/ dang po la/ rang 'bras rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid 'ong 'byin rung du lung du bstan pa'i rigs gnas kyi chos/ dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ don dam pa'i dge ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ kun slong gi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ thar ba lta bu ste/ dge ba'i sgrar btags pa yin gyi/ de dngos min no/ /gnyis pa ni dad pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni dad pas kun nas bslangs pa'i las lta bu/ bzhi ba ni las de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang sems byung lta bu'o/

/srog gcod spong ba'i las sogs la'ang des mtshon nas shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa la/ rang 'bras rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid mi 'ong 'byin rung du lung du bstan pa'i rigs gnas kyi chos/ mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la sgras brjod rigs kyis dbye na/ don dam pa'i mi dge ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba/ kun slong gi mi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi mi dge ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba lta ba ste/ mi dge ba dngos min yang de'i sgrar bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkon cog la ma dad pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i las lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung lta bu'o/ /srog gcod kyi las sogs la'ang des mtshon par bya'o/ /gsum pa la/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yid 'ong dang yid mi 'ong gang rung 'byin mi nus pa'i chos/ lung ma bstan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ don dam pa'i lung ma bstan sogs bzhi las/ dang po ni/ stong nyid lta bu/ /gnyis pa ni/ phan gnod gang yang ma yin pa'i byis pa'i rtse las lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ de kun nas slong byed kyi bsam pa lta bu/ bzhi ba ni de dang mtshungs ldan du gyur ba'i sems sems byung lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang*/ de la sgrib lung ma bstan dang ma sgrib lung ma bstan gnyis yod pa'i dang po ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang bden 'dzin thams cad/ gnyis pa ni nam mkha' sogs 'dus ma byas rnams so/ /de gsum gyi dang po blang bya/ bar ba dor bya/ phyi ma btang snyoms su bzhag bya yin no/ / gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs kyi mtshan nyid gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus zhig 'chad pa la gsum/ kun btags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub bo/ /dang po ni/ rang 'dzin rtog pas sgro btags tsam/ kun btags kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na gnyis/ rnam grangs pa'i kun btags dang*/ mtshan nyid yongs chad kyi kun btags so/ /dang po la gnyis/ ngo bo dang khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags dang*/

de las gzhan pa'i kun btags so/ /dang po ni/ sngon po la gzugs so zhes btags pa'i btags cha de ngo bo dang*/ sngon po 'di ni skye'o 'gag go mi rtag go mdzes so zhes sogs btags pa'i btags cha de/ khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags te/ de bzhin du lto ldir ba la bum pa'o zhes btags pa'i cha de ngo bo dang*/ che'o chung ngo zhes sogs btags pa'i cha de/ khyad par la kun btags pa'i kun btags yin la/ chos thams cad la'ang des mtshon par byar yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha'/ dngos med/ rtag pa la sogs pa yin no/ /chos gang yin kyang de dang gcig /de dang tha dad/ de'i ldog pa sogs kyang rnam grangs pa'i kun btags yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid yongs chad kyi kun btags ni/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin gyis sgro btags pa ltar gyi bdag dang*/ bden 'dzin gyis sgro btags pa ltar gyi bden grub dang*/ sgra rtag pa sogs med pa'i rigs rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ dag ma dag gi gzhan dbang gnyis sam/ gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum/ gzhan dbang dang*/ dngos po/ mi rtag pa/ 'dus byas/ skyes pa rnams don gcig cing go sla bas 'dir mi brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug /yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ stong nyid bcu drug /stong nyid/ yongs grub don gcig yin pas na/ gzugs sogs kyi chos gang yin kyang*/ rang nyid bden par med pa dang*/ don dam par med pa stong nyid yin pas khyab pa ltar yongs grub yin pas kyang khyab bo/ /gzhan yang*/ gzugs sogs gzhan dbang gi chos rnams kyi steng du bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin gyis ji ltar sgro btags pa'i cha rnams kun btags yin la/ des btags pa ltar bden par ma grub pa yongs grub tu 'jog pa yin no/ /gsum pa sems dang sems byung gi khyad par bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/

rang gi 'khor du gyur ba'i sems byung dang mtshungs ldan du gyur ba'i gtso bo rnam rig de/ gtso sems kyi mtshan nyid/ sems dang*/ rnam shes/ rnam rig rnams don gcig /dbye na/ mig gi rnam par shes pa sogs rnam shes tshogs drug dang*/ nyon mongs can dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i sems gnyis yod/ gzhan yang*/ gtso sems rnams ni/ don gyi ngo bo rig pa'i sgo nas bzhag la/ sems byung rnams ni/ don gyi khyad par rig pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa yang yin te/ dbus mtha' las/ de la don dam rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad par sems las byung*/ /zhes dang*/ de'i 'grel par/ don gyi ngo bo tsam rig pa ni rnam par shes pa'o/ /don gyi khyad par rig pa ni sems las byung ba rnams te tshor ba la sogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang yul gyi gtso bo'i dbang du byas shing so skye'i gtso sems kyis yul gyi khyad par mi rtogs pa ni ma yin te/ de'i mig gi rnam par shes pas ni/ sngon po'i ngo bo dang de'i khyad par mdzes mi mdzes sogs kyang rtogs la/ mig gi rnam shes kyi 'khor du gyur ba'i sems byung gis kyang sngon po dang de'i khyad par gnyis ka rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de'i sngo 'dzin dbang bo'i mngon sum gyis de ltar mthong ba'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ de phyir dngos po mthong ba yis/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthong ba nyid/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa sems byung bshad pa la gnyis/ mtshan nyid dang*/ dbye ba'o/ / rang nyid 'khor du byed pa'i gtso sems kyi 'khor du byung ba'i rig pa de/ sems byung gi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa de la sde tshan gyis dbye na/ kun 'gro lnga/ yul nges lnga/ dge ba bcu gcig /rtsa nyon drug /nye nyon nyi shu/ gzhan 'gyur bzhi ste sde tshan drug dang*/ phye na sems byung nga gcig yod/ dang po kun 'gro la/ gtso sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro ba'i rigs gnas kyi sems byung de/

kun 'gro'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ dbye na/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ sems pa/ reg pa/ yid byed dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ sim gdung bar ma gsum gang rung myong ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i sems byung de/ tshor ba'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ 'og ma phal cher la'ang zhib cha cung zad byed na sgo nas bzhag pa'i zhes sbyor/ dbye na/ tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum mam/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba sogs drug gnyis pa la/ yul gyi spu ris mi 'dra ba 'dzin pa'i sems byung de/ 'du shes kyi ngo bo/ dbye na/ rtog bcas kyi 'du shes dang*/ rtog med kyi 'du shes gnyis/ gsum pa ni/ sems yul la g.yo bar byed pa'i sems byung de/ sems pa'i ngo bo/ dbye na/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'khor du gyur pa'i sems pa sogs drug /bzhi ba ni/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa la brten nas yul gyi 'gyur ba yongs su gcod pa'i sems byung de/ reg pa'i ngo bo/ dbye na/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drug lnga ba ni/ sems kyi 'jug pa nges pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i sems byung de/ yid byed kyi ngo bo/ dbye na/ tshul bzhin dang*/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed gnyis so/ /sde tshan gnyis pa la/ yul so sor nges par byed pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i sems byung de/ yul nges kyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ dbye na/ 'dun pa/ mos pa/ dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ yul ma 'ongs pa 'thob pa don du gnyer ba'i sems byung de/ 'dun pa'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar bsams pa'i don bzhin du 'dzin par 'dod pa'i sems byung de/ /mos pa'i ngo bo/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs rnam mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid du gyur ba'i sems byung de/ dran pa'i ngo bo/ bzhi ba ni/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig pas phye ba'i sems byung de/ ting 'dzin gyi ngo bo/ lnga ba ni/ dmigs pa'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i sems byung de/

shes rab kyi ngo bo'o/ /sde tshan gsum pa la/ ma dad pa sogs gang yang rung ba'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i sems pa de/ sems byung dge ba'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ dbye na/ dad pa dang*/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod pa/ bag yod/ btang snyoms/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug med pa'i dge ba gsum dang*/ brtson 'grus/ shin sbyangs te bcu gcig go /dang po ni/ yon tan dang yon tan can sogs yul khyad par can la dga' ba'i sems byung de/ dad pa'i mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ ngo tsha shes pa/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas nas de la 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ khrel yod/ bzhi ba ni/ kha na ma tho ba la sems srung snang byed pa'i sems byung de/ bag yod/ lnga ba ni/ phyogs ris su mi gcod pa'i sems byung de/ btang snyoms/ drug pa ni/ gzhan la tho 'tsham par mi byed pa'i sems byung de/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ bdun pa ni/ zag bcas kyi yo byad sogs la ma chags pa'i sems byung de/ 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba/ brgyad pa ni/ kun nas mnar sems med pa'i sems byung de/ zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba/ dgu ba ni/ las 'bras rags pa la rmongs pa med pa'i sems byung de/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba/ bcu ba ni/ dge ba'i bya ba la mngon par spro ba'i sems byung de/ brtson 'grus/ bcu gcig pa ni/ sems las su rung bar byed pa'i sems byung de/ 'dir shin sbyangs kyi ngo bo ste/ lus shin sbyangs ni de min no/ /sde tshan bzhi ba la/ srid pa'i rtsa ba byed pa'i rigs gnas kyi nyon mongs de/ rtsa nyon gyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ /dbye na/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom nyon mongs can/ lta ba nyon mongs can te lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ zag bcas kyi dngos po la kun nas sred pa'i sems byung de/ 'dod chags kyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/

gnyis pa ni/ kun nas mnar sems kyi gzhi dang bcas pa'i sems byung de/ khong khro/ gsum pa ni/ 'jig lta'i dbang gis sems khengs pa'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i sems byung de/ nga rgyal/ bzhi ba ni/ rig pa ye shes kyi 'gal zla'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i sems byung rmongs pa de/ ma rig pa/ lnga ba ni/ rang yul la don mi 'gyur du dogs pa'i sems byung de/ the tshom nyon mongs can/ drug pa ni/ rang yul la kun tu rtog pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ lta ba nyon mongs can/ 'di la dbye na/ 'jig lta/ mthar lta/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba ste lnga/ nyer len gyi phung bo la dmigs nas bdag gam bdag gir 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ 'jig lta/ 'jig ltas bzung ba ltar gyi bdag de rtag chad gang rung du 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ mthar lta/ las 'bras sogs yul yod pa'i don la med par lta ba'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ log lta/ lta ba dman pa la mchog tu rlom zhing mngon par zhen nas 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dman pa la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i shes rab nyon mongs can de/ tshul zhugs mchog 'dzin te/ snga ma chags sogs lnga la lta min lnga dang*/ phyi ma 'di lnga la lta ba lnga zhes grag go /sde tshan lnga ba la/ rtsa nyon dang nye bar gyur pa'i nyon mongs de/ nye nyon gyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ dbye na/ der gyur pa'i khro ba dang*/ khon 'dzin/ 'chab pa/ 'tshig pa/ phrag dog ser sna/ g.yo/ rgyags pa/ rnam 'tshe/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa/ ma dad pa/ le lo/ bag med/ brjed ngas/ shes bzhin min pa/ rnam g.yeng ste nyi shu'o/ /dang po ni/ gnod byed sogs la yid 'khrugs pa'i sems byung btags yod de/ khro ba/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar gyi gnod byed la sha gnyer ba mi gtong ba'i sems byung de/

'khon 'dzin/ gsum pa ni/ kha na ma tho ba zur gyis sbed par byed pa'i sems byung de/ 'chab pa/ bzhi ba ni/ khro ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas tshig rtsub 'dren par byed pa'i sems byung de/ 'tshig pa/ lnga ba ni/ gzhan gyi phun tshogs la yid 'khrugs pa'i sems byung de/ phrag dog /drug pa ni/ zag bcas kyi yo byad sogs la dam du 'dzin pa'i sems byung de/ ser sna/ bdun pa ni/ nyes pa 'ga' zhig zur gyis mi mngon par gzhan du sgyur ba'i sems byung de/ sgyu/ brgyad pa ni/ yon tan khyad par gyi chos de dang mi ldan bzhin du ldan pa ltar ston pa'i sems byung de/ g.yo/ dgu ba ni/ rang gi yo byad sogs la chags shing dregs pa'i sems byung de/ rgyags pa/ bcu ba ni/ gzhan la tho 'tsham pa'i sems byung de/ rnam par 'tshe ba/ bcu gcig pa ni/ rang dang chos gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ ngo tsha med pa/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ gzhan rgyu mtshan du byas nas kha na ma tho ba la mi 'dzem pa'i sems byung de/ khrel med pa/ bcu gsum pa ni/ lus sems blong blong por byed pa'i sems byung de/ rmugs pa/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ sems ma zhi bar byed pa can gyi sems byung de/ rgod pa/ bco lnga pa ni/ yon tan dang yon tan can sogs la mi gus pa'i sems byung de/ ma dad pa/ bcu drug pa ni/ dge ba la mi spro ba'i sems byung de/ le lo/ bcu bdun pa ni/ rang dgar spyod pa phyin ci log tu byed pa'i sems byung de/ bag med/ bco brgyad pa ni/ dge ba'i dmigs rnam brjed par byed pa'i sems byung de/ brjed ngas/ bcu dgu pa ni/ bya ba de mi shes pa'am dran pa yengs nas 'jug pa'i sems byung de/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ nyi shu ba ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa las yid phyir 'phro bar byed pa'i sems byung de/ rnam g.yeng ngo*/ /sde tshan drug pa la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum po gang du yang gcig tu ma nges par 'gyur bar srid pa'i rigs gnas kyi sems byung de/

gzhan 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid dam ngo bo/ dbye na/ gnyid/ 'gyod pa/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa ste bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ lus sems kun nas sdud par byed pa'i sems byung de/ gnyid/ gnyis pa ni/ byas zin pa'i don la yid 'phyo ba'i sems byung de/ 'gyod pa/ gsum pa ni/ yul la rtsing ba'i rnam pa can gyi sems byung de/ rtog dpyod gnyis kyi nang nas rtog pa/ bzhi pa ni/ yul la zhib pa'i rnam pas 'jug pa'i sems byung de/ de gnyis kyi nang nas dpyod pa'o/ /de dag ni mngon pa gong ma'i lugs gtso che la/ mngon pa mdzod las/ sems kyis mang bcu/ dge ba'i sa ba bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa ba drug /mi dge ba'i sa ba gnyis/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa ba bcu/ ma nges pa'i sa ba brgyad de sde drug bshad pa'i/ dang po bcu ni/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ sems pa/ 'dun pa/ reg pa/ blo gros/ dran pa/ yid byed/ mos pa/ ting 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa bcu ni/ dad pa/ bag yod/ shin sbyangs/ btang snyoms/ ngo tsha shes pa/ khrel yod/ chags med/ sdang med/ mi 'tshe ba/ brtson 'grus so/ /gsum pa drug ni/ rmongs pa/ bag med/ le lo/ ma dad pa/ rmugs pa/ rgod pa'o/ /bzhi ba gnyis ni/ ngo tsha med pa dang*/ khrel med pa'o/ /lnga ba bcu ni/ khro ba/ 'khon 'dzin/ g.yo/ phrag dog 'tshig pa/ 'chab pa/ ser sna/ sgyu/ rgyags pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba'o/ /drug pa brgyad ni/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ the tshom bzhi dang*/ rtog dpyod gnyid 'gyod de gzhan 'gyur bzhi'o/ /so sor phye na zhe drug /de rnams kyi ngo bo ji lta bu yin pa ni/ sngar bshad pa des shes so/ /de rnams mngon pa gong 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin yin te/ lung phran tshegs sogs nas 'byung ba gzhan yang yod do/ /ces pa 'di yang*/ dka' bcu blo bzang bsam 'grub dang*/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs seng ge rnam pa gnyis kyis dad pas kun nas bslangs te/ dpe snga ma par du brko bar bzhed pa'i tshe/ blo gsar gzhan la phan par 'gyur srid snyam nas zhar byung du bshad sgrub ming can gyis mdor bsdus nas sbyar ba ste/

nyon mongs kyi mtshan nyid skye tshul sogs zhib cha 'don na/ mngon pa kun btus rtsa 'grel dang*/ mdzod rtsa 'grel la'ang blta bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos tshul ji snyed pa'i/ /grangs kyi pha mtha'i tshad ni ji tsam pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes kyis kyang gzhal min phyir/ /de yi brjod bya dag kyang tshad dang bral/ /de phyir gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po las/ /cha tsam gzhan phan ched du bkod pa nyid/ /dad pas par du bskrun pa'i rab dkar dge /ji snyed mchis gang de yang 'gro ba kun/ /mtha' yas gzhung lugs chu gter cher zhugs te/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i dri ma kun bkrus nas/ /gtan bde bla med byang chub chen po'i sar/ /bde blag nyid du 'jug pa'i phyir bsngo'o// //dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ gzhung lugs du ma'i brjod bya bstan pa nyer mkho blo ldan dga' byed bzhugs/ - PAGE 168-- PAGE 167-- PAGE 166-
